number: 第二百四十八条の四の二十四
heading_en: Sensitivities, etc. of Delta Risk Factors for Reference Credit Spreads
summary_ja: 参照先のクレジット・スプレッドのデルタ・リスク・ファクターは、バケット内の全参照先・全テナーのスプレッドの絶対変化とし、リスク・ウェイトを表で定める。
summary_en: The reference credit spread delta risk factor is the absolute change in credit spreads across all reference names and tenors in a bucket, with risk weights from a table.
paragraphs: The delta risk factor relating to reference credit spreads shall be the absolute change in the credit spreads of all tenors relating to all reference names in the bucket.

The "absolute change in the credit spread" in the preceding paragraph means the value obtained by dividing the change in the value of CVA or of a CVA hedging instrument when the credit spreads of all tenors relating to all reference names in the bucket are changed by one basis point by 0.0001.
The risk weight RW_{k} of the risk factor provided in paragraph (1) shall be as set out in the following table, according to the bucket number. {{T:p293t1}}
